dates.event: Mentoring organizations can begin submitting applications to Google
Google program administrators review organization applications
List of accepted mentoring organizations published
Potential GSoC contributors discuss application ideas with mentoring organizations
GSoC contributor proposal rankings due from Org Admins
Mentors and GSoC contributors can begin submitting midterm evaluations (for standard 12 week coding projects)
Final week: GSoC contributors submit their final work product and their final mentor evaluation
Mentors submit final GSoC contributor evaluations
GSoC contributors with extended timelines continue coding
Final date for all GSoC contributors to submit their final work product and final evaluation
Final date for mentors to submit evaluations for GSoC contributor projects with extended deadlines

typical_timing: Mentoring Organization applications open for OSS projects (application period is 2 weeks)
Google reviews all Mentoring Org applications (3 week period)
Interested applicants reach out to Mentoring Orgs to discuss their project ideas (4 weeks)
Aspiring GSoC contributors apply and submit their project proposals to orgs (15 day period)
Mentors and Org Admins review all contributor applications and rank their selections
Google Admins review Org requests and resolve duplicative selections
Community Bonding period (3 week period for contributors to understand codebase, start integrating into their OSS community, set milestones with mentors, etc.)
Coding Period Begins (~75% of projects are 12 weeks; project length can be 8-22 weeks)
eligibility: Be eighteen (18) years of age or older upon registration for the Program
Be eligible to work in the country in which they reside
Not be an Organization Administrator or Mentor in the Program
Be a student or a beginner to open source software development
prepare: Accept the terms of the GSoC Contributor Agreement
Submit a Project Proposal through the Program Website during the application period
